homekit.code_manquant: choose the HomeKit code (8 digits, not 12345678 nor all the same) and file it: printf %s "$C" | moli-os secrets set {instance} {code}, then restart Moli
homekit.code_invalide: the HomeKit code filed is not valid (8 digits, not 12345678 nor all the same): replace it (moli-os secrets set {instance} {code}), then restart Moli
